description: This file serves as an API client for authentication-related operations, including login, signup, and logout. It manages HTTP requests to a specified backend for user authentication and contains utility functions for network error handling.

methods.name: handleNetworkError(err)
methods.description: Utility function to interpret fetch-related network errors, particularly handling CORS and connectivity issues.

methods.name: login({ email, password }, extraHeaders={})
methods.description: Function that authenticates a user with email and password, returning user info and an access token.

methods.name: signup({ email, password, full_name }, extraHeaders={})
methods.description: Function that registers a new user with email, password, and full name, returning user info and possibly an access token.

methods.name: logout(_, extraHeaders={})
methods.description: Function that logs out the user, sending a POST request to the backend logout endpoint.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^export async function login({ email, password }, extraHeaders={}) {$/

ctags.name: signup
ctags.pattern: /^export async function signup({ email, password, full_name }, extraHeaders={}) {$/
